title: Nerve configuration
description: Schema for Nerve base configuration, optional overlay configuration, and CLI-overridable fields.

x-config-sources.name: Overlay config file
x-config-sources.description: Optional deep-merge overlay loaded after the base config.

x-config-sources.name: CLI overrides
x-config-sources.description: Typed flags applied after config files.

x-config-precedence.description: Highest precedence. Explicit runtime overrides for selected fields.
Deep-merged on top of the base config after service file loading.

x-load-order: Resolve service_conf_dir in this order: CLI override, overlay, base config.
Load per-service YAML/JSON files from service_conf_dir into services.
Deep-merge overlay config on top of the base+service config.
Apply CLI overrides (including --instance-id aliases and typed global flags).

instance_id.description: Instance identifier reported to service discovery backends.

services.description: Map of service name to service configuration.

heartbeat_path.description: Optional path for a heartbeat file touched on each main loop iteration.

service_conf_dir.description: Optional directory containing per-service YAML/JSON config files.

max_repeated_report_failures.description: Maximum consecutive reporter failures before stopping a watcher.

histogram_buckets_zk.description: Histogram bucket boundaries for ZooKeeper operation metrics.

histogram_buckets_main_loop.description: Histogram bucket boundaries for main loop duration metrics.

service.description: Configuration for a single service watcher.

host.description: Host that checks should target by default.

port.description: Port that checks should target by default.

reporter_type.description: Reporter backend type. Built-in values are zookeeper and etcd.

check_mocked.description: If true, skip checks and report the service as healthy.

checks.description: Health checks for this service. All checks must pass for the service to be considered up.

max_repeated_report_failures.description: Per-service override for max consecutive report failures before stopping watcher.

load_test_concurrency.description: If set, Nerve launches this many watcher instances for the service.

weight.description: Optional service weight included in reporter payload.

haproxy_server_options.description: Optional HAProxy server options included in reporter payload.

labels.description: Optional labels included in reporter payload.

zk_hosts.description: Required when reporter_type is zookeeper. List of ZooKeeper hosts.

zk_path.description: Required when reporter_type is zookeeper. Parent path for ephemeral registration keys.

use_path_encoding.description: When true, encode full payload into the ZooKeeper child key where possible.

etcd_host.description: Required when reporter_type is etcd. Etcd host.

etcd_path.description: Etcd parent path where service keys are created.

rate_limiting.description: Token-bucket rate limiter for status transition reports.

shadow_mode.description: When true, throttling is observed but updates are still sent.

average_rate.description: Average allowed status transitions per second.

max_burst.description: Maximum burst size when tokens are available.

check.description: Health check definition. Built-in check types are noop, tcp, http, redis, and rabbitmq.

type.description: Check type. Custom external checks are also supported via plugins.

module.description: Optional Ruby module/gem to require for custom check types.

name.description: Optional check name. Defaults to a generated name if omitted.

host.description: Target host. Defaults to the service host if omitted.

port.description: Target port. Defaults to the service port if omitted.

rise.description: Consecutive successes required to transition to up.

fall.description: Consecutive failures required to transition to down.

uri.description: Required for http checks. Request path, for example /health.

ssl.description: HTTP check only. Use TLS when true.

read_timeout.description: HTTP check only. Socket read timeout in seconds.

open_timeout.description: HTTP check only. Connection open timeout in seconds.

ssl_timeout.description: HTTP check only. TLS handshake timeout in seconds.

headers.description: HTTP check only. Additional request headers.

expect.description: HTTP check only. Substring expected in response body.
